doc_title_en: Notice on Completion of Acquisition and Public Tender Offer for Thien Long Group Corporation Subsidiary Status (Stock Acquisition with Change in Specified Subsidiary)
doc_title_jp: （開示事項の経過）Thien Long Group Corporationの子会社化及び公開買付けに関するお知らせ（特定子会社の異動を伴う株式取得）

key_facts.method: 株式取得（ベトナム当局承認後完了）
key_facts.reason_jp: Thien Long Group Corporationの子会社化

summary_en: Kokuyo completed acquisition of all shares in Thien Long An Thinh Investment Corporation, indirectly obtaining 46.82% of Thien Long Group Corporation's issued shares. The acquisition follows regulatory approval from Vietnamese authorities. Thien Long Group is expected to become a consolidated subsidiary on January 1, 2027, following approval at the company's extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for December 7, 2026.
summary_jp: ベトナム当局の許認可取得を経て、Thien Long An Thinh Investment Corporationの全株式取得を完了。これによりThien Long Group Corporationの発行済株式総数の46.82%を間接取得した。2027年1月1日付でThien Long Groupを連結子会社化する予定。
tag_en: M&A: Completion of Thien Long An Thinh Investment acquisition
tag_jp: ベトナム子会社の間接取得完了、TLG社支配権獲得へ

doc_title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock and Change in Treasury Stock Cancellation Policy
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の消却および自己株式の消却方針の変更に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率の向上および株式の希薄化懸念の払拭

summary_en: KOKUYO will cancel 24.0 million shares on November 26, 2026, representing 5.4% of issued shares including treasury stock. The company is lowering its treasury stock retention target from 2% to 1% of issued shares to improve capital efficiency and address dilution concerns.
summary_jp: コクヨは11月26日付で普通株式2,400万株を消却する。発行済株式総数（自己株式を含む）に対する割合は5.4％。資本効率の向上と希薄化懸念の払拭を目的に、保有自己株式の目安を発行済株式総数の2％以下から1％以下に引き下げる。
